snippet.title: No Return Ticket — Because Bali Is a "Magic Island"
snippet.description:
I met two travelers from Russia on a beach in Bali. Here’s what they shared:

• They were spending the day here at Melasti Beach
• One arrived just three days ago — without a return ticket. The other arrived about a week ago, with a stopover in Bangkok on the way from Moscow, and might stay until spring
• Why Bali: “because it’s a magic island” — and it’s like a second home, since one of them has lived here before for around three years
• Their work: he’s a photographer, and she stopped working in Moscow — now she’s just living her best life
• Their favourite place: Bedugul, up in the north. It’s cooler there, with fresh air and less heat than the beach, plus beautiful nature — mountains, lakes, jungle — and everything absolutely green, as if the saturation were turned all the way up

Real street interview on a beach in Bali 🌍

#russiangirl #balitravel #balilife

snippet.title: She couldn't go home, so they cooked it in New York
snippet.description:
Amy Besa and Romy Dorotan, two Filipinos, paid around $35,000 a month in rent for a SoHo restaurant that served Philippine food.

That's the part the video didn't have room for. A restaurant like that doesn't just get easier once the critics love it.

They knew that, so they didn't only cook. In 2006 they wrote it all down in a cookbook, Memories of Philippine Kitchens, and the next year it won the Jane Grigson Award. Filipino recipes, now on a shelf with a prize on it.

But the rent was the rent.

In 2009, Cendrillon closed.

So they started over. That same year they opened Purple Yam in Brooklyn, and it stayed open until 2024. Then it closed too.

What I keep thinking about is what Amy wrote when it did. She said the world turns on food, and that it's the most powerful weapon we have for bringing people together.

Think about who was saying that. A student who was told not to come home, who then spent her life building a table where other people could come in. 🇵🇭

Sources: Long Distance (National Film Society), The FilAm, Rappler and others

아이들은 다 말해요! 😂
우리 집의 진정한 서열 1위는 누구일까요? 호기롭게 "대장은 아빠요!"라고 외치던 꼬마. 하지만 알고 보니 눈치 100단이었습니다. "아빠가 저기 앉아 있어서 그렇게 말한 거예요. 진짜 대장은 엄마예요!" 🤣 아빠의 체면을 세워주려던 꼬마의 귀여운 배려에 스튜디오는 웃음바다가 됐습니다! 그리고 꼬마에게 예절 교육을 받았다는 아빠의 사연! "제가 아빠한테 '부탁해(Please)'라고 말하라고 가르쳤어요." 아빠가 그 말을 잘 쓰냐고요? "네! '부탁이야, 엄마한테 말하지 마'라고 할 때 써요!" 🤣 아빠들의 생존 본능, 이 정도면 눈물겹네요!
여러분 집의 진짜 대장은 누구인가요? 아빠가 "엄마한테 말하지 마"라고 한 적 있나요? ㅋㅋㅋ 댓글로 재밌는 가족 썰을 남겨주세요! 👇
오늘도 크게 웃고 갑니다! 구독과 좋아요 부탁드려요 ❤️
